categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, manufacturing, and sales of disposable sterile infusion medical devices, including syringes, infusion and blood transfusion sets, medical puncture needles, and other diagnostic and clinical care products. It operates mainly through an ODM plus integrated supply model, serving international medical device brand owners with one-stop procurement solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced automated production equipment and mature manufacturing processes, including automated assembly and packaging technologies for infusion devices. It has developed core technologies in safety products such as safety blood collection needles and safety injection needles, and maintains a comprehensive quality management system compliant with international standards like ISO13485, FDA QSR 820, and EU MDR.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are international medical device brand owners primarily in Asia, Europe, and the Americas, with sales covering over 80 countries and regions. The company serves hospitals and healthcare providers through both export (ODM) and domestic sales channels, focusing on medical consumables used in infusion therapy and injection.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with its headquarters in Anhui Province, and has a broad international sales network covering Asia, Europe, and the Americas. Export sales account for approximately 97% of total revenue, indicating a strong global market presence.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream of the medical device supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing and assembly of disposable sterile infusion medical devices. It sources raw materials like polyethylene and polypropylene and supplies finished products to brand owners and distributors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include innovation-driven development with continuous investment in R&D to enhance core technologies and product quality. Current R&D projects focus on safety and smart infusion devices, such as automatic retractable needles, smart wearable precision injectors, and needle-free injectors. The company aims to expand its product line and improve manufacturing automation and efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of disposable sterile infusion medical devices and related medical consumables. The company operates an ODM model for international brand owners and a buyout distribution model domestically, with sales predominantly from physical product shipments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the leading specialized manufacturers in China for disposable sterile infusion medical consumables, with competitive advantages in automation, quality control, and innovation. It competes in a fragmented and highly competitive market with many manufacturers but differentiates through focused expertise and stable international customer relationships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 477 million, a 10.54% decrease from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 40 million, down 33.68%. Total assets were around RMB 873 million, showing a slight growth. The company faces pressure from global trade policies and market competition but maintains positive cash flow from operations.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes superior product quality, safety features, and technological innovation in disposable sterile infusion devices. Its high degree of production automation reduces contamination risks and costs, while its focused expertise in infusion consumables enables rapid market response and stable supply. The company also offers integrated supply solutions to international brand owners, enhancing customer convenience and trust.
